post_meta.title: Donohue 6/24
post_meta.text: Donohue 6/24 NOBO. Continuous snow on the Lyell headwall side, moderate angle, good steps, spikes used morning only. The flats before the climb are slush lakes by noon. Rush Creek upper ford thigh high and pushy at 3pm, camped and crossed at 6am instead, knee high and fine.

post_meta.title: Donohue 7/12
post_meta.text: Donohue 7/12 NOBO. Lyell side has long snow flats, slushy by 10, ankle deep postholes but flat so whatever. Pass itself clear. Rush Creek fords were the news, the upper one was thigh high and fast at 2pm, take the morning.
